name: Devanagari Standard Three-Field Form (Synthetic Development Fixture)
description: Synthetic development template fixture containing three primary fields: applicant_name, submission_date, and declared_amount. Coordinates are normalized [norm_x1, norm_y1, norm_x2, norm_y2] in range [0.0, 1.0].

fields.description: Handwritten applicant full name in Devanagari script
Handwritten date in DD/MM/YYYY format in Devanagari or Arabic digits
Handwritten monetary figure in Devanagari or Arabic numerals
